beats.say: Leo Reich writes, stars and creates the new comedy himself, a rare triple‑threat.
Paramount+ bought the A24 comedy series, confirming its UK launch and streaming debut soon.
Zadie Smith narrates every episode, adding literary flair that sets the tone apart.
Andrew Scott and Lena Dunham pop up as surprise guests, raising the star power.
Emily Fairn joins the cast, bringing fresh energy that lifts the jokes even higher.
Ready for Leo Reich’s triple‑threat comedy? What will you binge tonight on Paramount+?
